title: A Blue Whale Eats 4 Tons of Tiny Shrimp Every Single Day

scenes.text: A blue whale eats about four tons of tiny shrimp every day.
They're called krill, and the whale swallows thousands of them in a single gulp.
It lunges at a swarm with its mouth wide open.
Its throat balloons out to hold an enormous mouthful of water.
Then it pushes the water back out and swallows what's left.
The biggest animal that ever lived survives on some of the smallest.

description:
A blue whale eats about four tons of krill in a day.
It lunges into a swarm, balloons its throat, and filters out the water.
How does the biggest animal ever live on the smallest food?
first_comment: What is the biggest meal you have ever eaten? A whale beats it.
